strategies.text: Lightning Bolt and a summoned Earth Rumbler: kill the Rumbler, then Roogug. CC on adds is optional but helpful.
Kill adds first, Groundshaker before the rest. Dominate Mind controls a random player: crowd-control that player and avoid AoE near them. Stun him to interrupt casts.
Summons a Boar Spirit and uses Chain Heal. Tank straight through; taunt the spirit when it appears.
Hits hard; his two Spearhide adds Whirling Barrage, so crowd-control them. Thunderclap slows melee.
Lightning Bolt, an Earthbind Totem (slow) and an Earth Rumbler. Let the tank pick up the Rumbler; recovering a ranged pull is hard under the totem.
Pull her down from the hut using line of sight. Chain Bolt hits three targets (spread), she heals with Renew and uses Purity for brief immunity. Off-healing helps.
Charges the tank on the opening pull and enrages near death; keep active healing on the tank.
Sonic Burst silence and Ravage (hit plus stun on the tank). Ranged: stay close enough not to pull extra mobs, far enough not to be hit.

notes: Five boss positions are OpenMap (Encounter Journal) data and agree with the tinted rooms on the map picture. OpenMap also gives Roogug a position identical to Death Speaker Jargba's (about 0.87, 0.41), which looks like a copy, so Roogug is left without a position. Earthcaller Halmgar and the Blind Hunter (rares) have no position. NeedRoll was used only as a cross-check. Quest NPCs inside the dungeon (per Method): Willix the Importer (neutral), Heralath Fallowbrook (Alliance) and Charlga Razorflank (Horde, An Unholy Alliance); none has a position. No chests or interactive objects are known. The route follows the boss order of Method and the corridor layout; the Kraul is a maze, so treat the waypoints as rough.
